description: Ready-made delivery views and snapshot commands layered on the complete core profile: a live line map, a delivery history page and tracker and forge snapshots, configured rather than coded. Merge recovery preserves source occurrence time separately from observation, with unknown timing left unknown. Views show stage-specific recorded times and compact cross-repository pull request identities. Native runless review reports use bounded observational capture and candidate-bound shared cards. Originating closure details are collapsed by default in shared review cards. Ready and merge hooks receive an exact runner-derived single or batch check mode without changing admission. The line map gains a plan chapter from an optional delivery-plan/1 input: which criteria are proven, from the record and producer evidence, what changed since approval, and what needs the engineer. The plan chapter also shows how the plan was approved, from an optional planReview: one line for its review rounds and outcome, and a folded review track and cards; approvals marked blocking raise a flag until they are done. A binding may let the lead choose a candidate's checks from its diff, recorded per reviewed head and voided by a new head; the record, results, views and stats name the lead's choice and reason, and without the option the provider selects as before. Delivery records can hold lane ownership, current story assignments, and temporary flakes scoped to a base commit and check. Authorized base merges can retain an aligned review through hand-off. Integration-base setup records its target and uses the integration checkout for delivery. Record writers are pinned by applied archive digest and changed through a parked lead transition. Integration-base moves preserve recorded commit ancestry and recover publication and applied-writer reconciliation once. A stopped base rerun is told from a failed one, a named repair lands first and alone through a queue its broken base stopped, and batch members define a check alike when what it runs is alike. A lens re-checks each finding it deferred earlier, and one it does not list as fixed stays deferred. A round card says when an approval carried deferrable notes. A base move that changed nothing a check reads, by the binding's own declaration, carries that check, and deliveries that merge into one base on a machine share one merge slot. The line map labels a carried check, a flaky base run and a peer's merge. A bounded data-only public snapshot reuses line-map payloads while excluding history, raw artifacts and local execution details. Optional owned hosted publishing collects coherent source cuts, reconciles fenced writer receipts and keeps credentials out of view data and children. Owned hosted publishing starts or adopts an independent generation-aware watcher, bounds terminal close publication to 30 seconds, retains pending terminal cuts for ten-minute retries and supports credential-free archive viewing with explicit archive retry. Path-bearing public prose carries a visible omission marker while raw uploaded paths and configured secrets remain invalid. Credential-free terminal notifications reach an existing owner independently of lifecycle-lock contention and preserve one deadline per finished cut. Hosted publishing is qualified from exact built archive bytes in two independently configured adopters; the separately deployed viewer and its dependencies are excluded from workflow archives. Option-assigned local references and installed executable paths are omitted visibly from public prose and refused in raw uploads. Markdown, quote, bracket and diagnostic delimiters retain local-reference exclusion. ASCII punctuation includes Markdown emphasis; HTTPS URL components remain public prose. Closed URL wrappers leave adjoining local prose subject to exclusion while balanced URL punctuation survives. No-change settlement evidence uses public prose omission without changing private evidence or settlement identity. Workflows may consult an optional, read-only knowledge library after the repository's own solution notes, and report that it was not consulted when none is configured.
